summary: Frontend-only regression of Cloudflare Turnstile widget across the shared Captcha component consumers (Register, Home Newsletter, Home Consultation). Widget lazy-mounts on focusin, loads the Turnstile TEST sitekey (1x00000000000000000000AA), auto-solves to the Cloudflare 'Success! For testing only' badge on all three pages, and the Newsletter form submits successfully. No Content-Security-Policy violations related to challenges.cloudflare.com were emitted in the console. data-testid hooks (captcha, turnstile-widget, captcha-activate, captcha-reload) are all present.
critical_code_review_comments: Benign console warning observed once: 'Failed to execute postMessage on DOMWindow: target origin https://challenges.cloudflare.com does not match recipient origin' — this is emitted by Turnstile itself when the widget iframe is being torn down/unmounted (StrictMode double-mount or cleanup). It is not a CSP violation and does not affect verification, but the Captcha cleanup in /app/frontend/src/components/Captcha.jsx could suppress it by calling window.turnstile.remove(widgetId) only when the iframe is still attached, or by delaying remove(). Non-blocking.

Captcha.jsx picks TEST_SITEKEY for every non-production hostname, which is correct for preview but means the production sitekey is never exercised in preview. Consider a documented smoke test on the real production domain after deploy.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Turnstile TEST sitekey renders and auto-solves on Register (/register), Newsletter (home footer, data-testid=newsletter), and Consultation (home #consult, data-testid=consultation). Cloudflare iframe URL confirmed: https://challenges.cloudflare.com/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/.../1x00000000000000000000AA/dark/... . 0 CSP violations. Newsletter POST /api/newsletter returned success (toast contained 'subscribe'/'confirm'). Booking/consultation submit was NOT exercised end-to-end to avoid creating dummy leads and to avoid any Razorpay path; only widget presence + auto-solve verified for that form. If a future test needs to submit the booking form, use consent-checkbox where required and a TEST_ prefixed name/email so cleanup is easy. Admin login flow was already verified by main agent and skipped here.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Prior hCaptcha errors are resolved by the switch to Cloudflare Turnstile — the widget now renders and returns a token on all captcha-gated forms in the preview environment.
